stock: 18-inch wheels on base grades; 20-inch on top grades (market-dependent)

max_tire.note: IH8MUD owners report no rubbing on stock suspension. One LX owner on 275/70R18s had no rub at any AHC height or at full lock.
295/70R18s on stock wheels have been reported on an LX 700h Overtrail. Dissent Off-Road told a member that 35s on a +40 mm offset wheel fit with minimal to zero trimming.

items.title: 10-speed transmission can over-rev (Australia)
items.summary: If a linear solenoid fails, the transmission ECU may not tell the engine ECU, so the transmission can over-rev in some gears. That risks transmission damage, loss of power, and fluid leaking onto hot exhaust parts. Dealers reprogram the transmission ECU in about 30 minutes; 11,020 vehicles.

items.title: Can creep forward in neutral (Australia)
items.summary: A brake clutch disc in the 10-speed may not disengage in neutral, so the vehicle can creep at up to about 6 km/h on flat ground without the brake applied. Free software update; about 28,400 LandCruiser 300s and Tundras.

items.title: Stability control may not default to on (Australia)
items.summary: A software error can stop VSC defaulting to on at the next start if it was switched off and the brake was held between shutdown and restart (non-compliant with ADR 88/00). Free software update of about an hour; shared with the Kluger, RAV4 Hybrid and Mirai.

timeline.change: Unveiled 9 June 2021 on the GA-F frame, about 200 kg lighter than the 200. V8s are dropped for the 3.4 V35A-FTS twin-turbo petrol V6 and 3.3 F33A-FTV twin-turbo diesel V6 with a 10-speed automatic
Japan sales from 2 August; GR Sport added, the first Land Cruiser grade with front and rear diff locks on top of the centre lock
Australian launch on 5 October in GX, GXL, VX, Sahara, GR Sport and Sahara ZX grades

Early Australian trucks are covered by recalls XGG22 (stability control may not default to on; built 16 July 2021 to 1 April 2022) and ZGG04 (10-speed can creep in neutral; built 16 July 2021 to 12 January 2024). Both are software fixes, so check they have been done
February: Toyota pauses shipments of the F33A-FTV diesel and the 300s and LXs that use it after Toyota Industries finds irregularities in engine certification testing
The smaller J250 takes over the Land Cruiser name in North America; the 300 is never offered in the US or Canada
Hybrid powertrain introduced, debuting in the UAE with a redesigned front fascia
Updated Japanese range from 1 October: hybrid in ZX and GR Sport; diesel in ZX, GR Sport and GX
Performance Hybrid reaches Australia in GR Sport and Sahara ZX grades: 3.4 twin-turbo V6 plus a 36 kW motor, 341 kW/790 Nm combined, 3,500 kg towing

identify.intro: No 300 was ever sold new in the US, so any 'Land Cruiser 300' advertised there is either a Lexus LX or an import with a registration problem.

items.head: Model codes
items.body: VJA300 = 3.4 V35A-FTS twin-turbo petrol V6. FJA300 = 3.3 F33A-FTV twin-turbo diesel V6. GRJ300 = 4.0 1GR-FE V6 with a 6-speed automatic. VJH300 = V35A hybrid.

items.head: GR Sport lockers
items.body: The GR Sport has front and rear diff locks. Standard 300s lock only the centre diff, so check the switches if lockers matter to you.

items.head: US sibling
items.body: The Lexus LX 600 / LX 700h (J310) is the 300's US-market twin, on the same frame and powertrains. It's the only legal way to own this platform new in the US.

paragraphs: Toyota has never sold the J300 in the United States or Canada, citing slow 200 Series sales and limited production capacity. The Lexus LX is the US version of this platform.

Under the NHTSA 25-year exemption, the earliest 300s (production began in 2021) won't be eligible for US import until the mid-2040s. Until then the only route is a registered importer converting and certifying the vehicle, which in practice is almost never feasible.

production.intro: The 300 has been built in Japan since March 2021. Long order books early on meant wait times of years in some markets.
